android_mechanism: Progress broadcast emitted on every change; fix reports only meaningful updates
bug_description: WebPage's onProgressChange handler writes a hilog log line for every progress event. Web progress fires dozens of times per page load (per sub-resource), so opening any article emits a log storm on the UI thread (formatting + hilog IPC per event), adding overhead to every page load.
fix_summary: Progress is logged only at milestones (every 25% and completion), cutting per-event formatting and hilog traffic during page loads.
trigger_steps: Open an article from the home list (content-heavy page).
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched, hdf) before the tap.
Wait for the page to finish loading; repeat for 5 articles.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Count of hilog invocations from the app during page load (progress-event logs), and UI-thread CPU from tap to page-end.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed logs on every progress event (dozens per page); fixed logs <= 5 per page. unfixed page-load UI CPU > fixed.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 ace app sched -o /data/local/tmp/wan_progresslog.chtrace
